name: Kerrigan, Queen of Blades
guide_text: The Zerg gives you tempo so you can level fast while saving HP. I don't recommend playing into it and sell it at some point.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up to discover a Tier 3 zerg after you've upgraded your Zergs to Tier 3. Infestor is your best choice whenever offered and play into it for scaling. Ultralisk is the next best option. Buddy up a second time ASAP (when it costs 10-13) to try to hit more infestors. Quilboars and Nagas are the best tribes to add stuff to hand.
